name: Barbell Single-Arm Floor Press
steps: Lie faceup with feet apart and balance the center of the bar in one hand directly above your working shoulder.
Bend that elbow to lower the bar until your upper arm meets the floor.
Press it upward until the working arm straightens.
Switch sides after finishing this side.
tips: Keep both ends of the bar level and your opposite shoulder blade planted flat on the floor.
Keep your working elbow angled roughly 45 degrees from your ribs as your upper arm touches down.
